## Microsoft Expands Digital Twin Footprint in Healthcare

Healthcare digital twins represent a beachhead for MSFT to monetize Azure and Copilot at premium ASPs in a regulated industry; consistent expansion here strengthens the enterprise AI monetization narrative ahead of coming earnings.

- Microsoft is growing its digital twin presence in the healthcare vertical, per a simplywall.st analysis.
- Move signals AI-enabled vertical application expansion beyond core enterprise software.
- Healthcare is a high-value, regulated vertical where cloud and AI platforms can command premium pricing.
- Single-outlet coverage; medium classifier confidence — no corroborating sources.
